title: Live minimap of a page
blurb: A scrolling column of articles in a canvas, with every article drawn a second time at a sixth of its size in a strip beside it. The strip is the live elements: typing, a running build log and added articles show in it at once. An overview flies the articles out to a grid.
question: Can a canvas draw the articles of a scrolling page twice, once to read and once as a minimap, and keep native scrolling and input?
result: Yes, with one choice to make. If the scroll container is not drawable the pictures are whole and the page has to do the scrolling. If it is drawable the browser scrolls it and an article that repaints while half out of view loses the hidden half.
